en: The compassion of my people,
Pleading with his ancestral spirit,
He would split the hero's breast,
The hero turned it at the midpoint,
And struck the spear apart,
After the spear had broken,
When he was left alone behind the cart,
From Kenen in the contest,
The ember flared on the campaign,
Again he sharpened himself for the warrior's company,
Perhaps Chyntemir could not prevail,
Against the pleading Kalmak,
Both ears were firm,
Calling it hide from the sacred mane,
Calling it inward from the neck,
Calling it the work that opens your face,
Making the pale land into a hero's field,
Distracted, we made the ravager a hero,
Parted from the gray racehorse,
Why did we spill blood before us?
Blood flowed from the dark eyes,
Raging onward in blood,
His dear eyes turned blue,
Hero Kenen grew wrathful,
The camel-cutting sword at his waist,
The pale musket above his head.
